text: {"rejections": [{"option_id": "c1.r1a2", "rule_id": "app-service-request-timeout", "reason": "The Web API's requests may run long and App Service cuts off any request exceeding 230 seconds, which is a risk the requirements do not rule out, but the alternative itself is otherwise viable, so this is only a conditional concern and not a clear violation."}, {"option_id": "c4.r1a1", "rule_id": "redis-premium-only-features", "reason": "The current P1 Premium cache's clustering, persistence and virtual network features are not stated as unused, and the Standard C2/C3 alternative lacks them, so it clearly breaks this rule if any of those features are in use."}]}
